item.title: JHMR to open Casper Lift tomorrow, Bridger and Marmot Saturday
item.description: TETON VILLAGE, Wyo. — Jackson Hole Mountain Resort (JHMR) has announced that the Casper Lift will open tomorrow, Dec. 12., and the Bridger Gondola and Marmot Chair will open Saturday, Dec. 13. JHMR has shared season snowfall totals at the summit to be 105 inches, with 68 inches at mid-mountain. item.title: JHHS wins WY Thespian Festival, secures spot at international competition
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Talented actors alert! The Jackson Hole High School (JHHS) Thespian Troupe won first place at the Wyoming State Thespian Festival that was held from Dec. 4 to 6 on the University of Wyoming campus in Laramie.
